rows.quote: In this study, we used a longitudinal cohort of 54,306 participants from the UK Biobank Pharmacological Proteomics Project (UKB-PPP) to perform a comprehensive analysis of observed and genetic correlations between 2923 proteins and psoriasis susceptibility.
rows.coder_note: Step 3, rule C2: the sentence names the UKB-PPP as the cohort used; the outcome side of the dictionary has no row for UKB-PPP under any release (its only rows are on the pqtl side). No conflict at step 1, no outcome-side identifier at step 2.

Step 4, rules D and I1: UKB-PPP is named with counts (54,306; 51,789; 53,016) that equal no pqtl row's sample size; reference 6 (Sun 2023, DOI verified) is the source of four pqtl rows and no sentence carries an attribute that separates them exactly (the subcohort counts 46,673/6385/1268 equal no row's); no accession. The passages do not say the cis-pQTLs come from a GWAS of the authors' own, so rule C does not apply. No conflict at step 1.
